svg.aria-label: Session: the browser holds a random session ID in a cookie and the server looks it up in a session store on every request, which makes logout instant. Token: the client holds a signed token and any server can verify it without a lookup, which makes revocation harder.
svg.title: Session: the browser holds a random session ID in a cookie and the server looks it up in a session store on every request, which makes logout instant. Token: the client holds a signed token and any server can verify it without a lookup, which makes revocation harder.
svg.text: but can't easily revoke: keep it short-lived
